title: Role-Based Access Control
description: Users hold roles, roles grant permissions, and some roles conflict.
card: Users get their permissions through roles, such as clerk or approver.
Some roles conflict: whoever creates payments must not also approve them.
Nobody may hold two conflicting roles.
Administrators assign roles, and users can see what they are allowed to do.
typesPrompt: The system deals with users, roles and permissions.

requirements.text: Only registered users can hold roles.
A user can hold several roles, and a role can grant several permissions.
A role never conflicts with itself, and conflicts between roles are mutual.
No user may hold two conflicting roles (separation of duty).
An administrator can list a registered user's permissions: those granted by any of the user's roles.
An administrator can assign a role to a registered user.

fixedValues.conflicts: {clerk ↦ approver, approver ↦ clerk, developer ↦ operator, operator ↦ developer}
fixedValues.grants: {clerk ↦ createPayment, approver ↦ approvePayment, auditor ↦ readLedger, auditor ↦ readLogs, admin ↦ editUsers, developer ↦ readLogs, operator ↦ deployCode}
